title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027. The new route will put her back in headline rooms across the United States and Canada after she stepped away from touring in 2025.

The route opens in Nashville and ends in California, with stops in New York, Toronto, Chicago and Vancouver along the way. Radio City Music Hall and two nights at Massey Hall are the clearest signs of the jump in scale, giving Young a compact month-long run in larger rooms without turning the announcement itself into a list of 17 dates.

The name Everything Begins plays against Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo and fits the point at which the tour arrives. She returned to the stage this year with two sold-out hometown shows at London's O2 Academy Brixton and festival appearances including Reading and All Things Go. The new North American dates move that return back into headline rooms on a much larger scale.

That return has also brought new music. "From Down Here" arrived in May after Young went into the studio with James Blake, giving her a new song to carry into this chapter rather than simply extending the cycle around *I'm Only F**king Myself*. Its uneasy pull between missing the old highs and recognizing why they had to end makes it a natural bridge between the record she made before stepping back and the live career she is rebuilding now.

[youtube:-u9TRlZADmg]

Young returns with considerably more momentum than she had before "Messy" became a global breakthrough. The song won the 2026 Grammy for Best Pop Solo Performance, but the tour announcement does not lean only on that hit. The larger rooms booked across the route are a more useful measure of how her audience has changed, especially for a singer whose previous North American plans were interrupted before they could be completed.

Everything Begins is scheduled to start in Nashville and finish in Los Angeles less than a month later. Presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. The 17-show route picks up a live career that was interrupted last year and puts Young back in front of North American audiences with new music, bigger rooms and a tour built around her own name.
